description: Denies a reviewer agent launched on Haiku (inline shell and grep; no script file). Fails open when grep is missing or the input is not what it expects.

hooks.command: command -v grep >/dev/null || exit 0; i=$(cat); printf '%s' "$i" | grep -Eiq '"model" *: *"[^"]*haiku' && printf '%s' "$i" | grep -Eq '"subagent_type" *: *"[^"]*reviewer|SAFE TO LAND|Critical / Important / Minor' && { echo "review-routing: reviewers never run on Haiku; dispatch on sonnet, opus or fable" >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
